user.title: Home Assistant Utils
user.description: Install HA Utils and deploy bundled resources such as themes, packages, and blueprints into your Home Assistant config directory.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Home Assistant Utils is already configured.

user.title: Wind
user.description: Reads a gust sensor and a forecast weather entity. Publishes Level (safe / advisory / warning), Risk, Calm, and Gust factor. Device Guide explains the rise and fall lines.

user.title: Temperature
user.description: Merges an optional live temperature sensor with the forecast. Hot and Cold use your thresholds, which start at 90 and 32.

user.title: Bad weather
user.description: Merges an optional live rain sensor with the forecast. Turns on when either one reports bad weather.

signal_source_missing.title: Weather signal is missing a source
signal_source_missing.description: This signal needs {entities}. It stays unavailable until those entities exist again.
